plan_review.notes: Adopted review changes: periodic completion writes reuse the tick fresh read and defer ETag conflicts to the next interval; a process-wide invalidation epoch suppresses stale cross-instance fan-out; tick-start membership is explicit with closed instances skipped and mid-tick subscribers deferred; benchmark exercises actual remote-read callbacks for quiet and completion intervals.

independent_grade.notes: The change implements process-wide polling deduplication. The coordinator isolates one durable read and safely fans out the state and ETag snapshot, including closed subscribers, concurrent invalidation, overlapping ticks, and source-specific mutations. Tests cover the new behavior and the 80% request-reduction requirement. No repository policy violations or maintainability concerns remain.
